Restaurant Supervisor Job at Fresh County Limited




        
    

        
        Fresh County makes naturally delicious drinks from fruits and we are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Restaurant Supervisor

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary 
     

            
    




	A recruitment company located in Victoria Island is seeking for immediate employment, a Supervisor
	The Restaurant Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the restaurant, ensuring excellent customer service, maintaining high food quality and hygiene standards, supervising staff, and achieving operational excellence.
	The Supervisor ensures that all restaurant activities are carried out efficiently while promoting a positive work environment and delivering an exceptional customer experience.


Qualifications and Requirements


	Minimum of OND, HND, or Bachelor's Degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
	Minimum of 2–5 years of supervisory experience in a restaurant, hotel, or hospitality environment.
	Knowledge of restaurant operations, food safety, and customer service.


Salary
N150,000 per month.

Method of application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Supervisor" as the subject of the mail.

Note


	For proximity to work, only candidates leaving within Eti Osa local government are advised to apply
	Only shortlisted candidate will be contacted.

Network Adminstrator Job at Sophia ERP Limited




        
    

        
        Sophia ERP Limited (SEL) is an Enterprise Solutions Development Organization, on a mission to power Governments and Businesses with cost effective and suitable Digital Transformation solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Network Adminstrator

Job Location: Ojodu, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a skilled and proactive Network Administrator to manage, maintain, and secure the organization’s IT infrastructure and network environment.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, performance, and security of network systems, servers, and related technologies, while providing technical support, system administration, software support, and IT training to internal and external users.


Responsibilities
Network & Infrastructure Administration:


	Install, configure, manage, and maintain the organization’s network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, and network security systems
	Monitor network performance, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and ensure maximum uptime and reliability
	Manage LAN/WAN environments, VPN connections, internet services, and wireless network infrastructure
	Configure and maintain network security solutions, including firewalls, endpoint protection, access controls, and network monitoring tools
	Perform regular network assessments, performance tuning, and capacity planning
	Monitor server performance and support server administration tasks, including updates, patch management, and routine maintenance
	Implement and maintain backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures
	Ensure data security, system integrity, and compliance with organizational IT policies and standards
	Maintain and update network diagrams, configurations, inventories, and technical documentation
	Manage user accounts, permissions, group policies, and access rights across systems and applications
	Support cloud-based and on-premise infrastructure environments where applicable
	Coordinate with vendors, internet service providers, and third-party support teams when necessary


Technical Support & Systems Administration:


	Provide 1st-level technical support for hardware, software, systems, and network-related issues
	Diagnose and resolve network outages, system failures, and user connectivity problems in a timely manner
	Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, printers, and peripheral devices
	Support system upgrades, software deployments, and infrastructure improvement initiatives
	Monitor IT assets, licensing, and system utilization to ensure operational efficiency
	Support deployment, maintenance, and troubleshooting of business applications and enterprise systems


Software Application Testing and Training:


	Assist in testing software applications and updates before deployment to ensure functionality and compatibility
	Document test results, system issues, and resolutions for future reference
	Support users during application rollouts and system upgrades
	Conduct IT orientation and training sessions for staff on cybersecurity awareness, IT best practices, etc.
	Conduct Training on assigned Tech courses during coding bootcamps


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field
	1+ years of experience in network administration, systems administration, or IT infrastructure support
	Strong understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, and routing/switching
	Experience with network devices such as Cisco, MikroTik, or similar technologies is an advantage
	Familiarity with Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, virtualization, and backup solutions
	Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, firewall management, and endpoint security tools
	Experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools
	Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
	Excellent communication, documentation, and user support abilities
	Relevant certifications such as CCNA, Network+, MCSA, or equivalent are an added advantage
	Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively
	Candidate must reside in Lagos; proximity to the island is a plus.


Salary
N150,000 - N250,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Project Delivery Officer Job at MRT Net Solutions Limited




        
    

        
        MRT Net Solutions Limited  is a growing technology and business support company focused on providing practical solutions, professional services, and capacity-building opportunities for individuals, businesses, and organisations.

We are committed to excellence, innovation, structure, and service delivery. Our work environment encourages creativity, accountability, teamwork, and continuous learning.

At MRT, we believe in building systems that support growth, improve productivity, and create value for our clients and stakeholders.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Project Delivery Officer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time
     

            
    



Job Description


	MRT Net Solutions Limited is seeking a technology-inclined Project Delivery Officer to support the configuration, testing, implementation and successful delivery of its technology products.
	The officer will coordinate project activities, maintain documentation and train frontline and operational users.


Responsibilities


	Support the configuration and implementation of MRT’s products.
	Assist with gathering and documenting client requirements.
	Test configured products before deployment or client presentation.
	Identify, document and report system issues for resolution.
	Coordinate project activities, timelines, deliverables and follow-ups.
	Maintain project records, configuration documents and implementation reports.
	Prepare user manuals, training materials and project documentation.
	Conduct product demonstrations and end-user training.
	Train frontline, operational and intern-level users.
	Conduct end-user training independently when the senior officer is unavailable.
	Support users during onboarding, deployment and post-implementation stages.
	Communicate technical issues and client feedback to the Development team.
	Track outstanding project actions and provide progress reports.
	Ensure that completed projects meet agreed requirements and quality standards.


Requirements


	B.Sc. or HND in Information Technology, Computer Science, Project Management, Business Administration or a related discipline.
	One to three years’ experience in project delivery, software implementation, product support, training or a related role.
	Ability to learn, configure and support technology products.
	Good understanding of software testing and issue documentation.
	Strong project-coordination and organizational skills.
	Ability to train users and explain technical information clearly.
	Strong written communication, presentation and documentation skills.
	Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines.
	Willingness to work closely with technical teams and clients.


Salary
N150,000 - N200,000 per month.

Note


	Applicants must submit an updated CV and an accessible link to a two-to-three-minute video introduction explaining their relevant experience, technology competence, training ability and suitability for the position.
	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
